# Account Rift

> Buy game accounts and in-game items instantly — secure Stripe checkout, fast email delivery. No account registration required.

Account Rift is a userless e-commerce storefront selling game accounts and in-game items. Customers pick a product, pay with Stripe Checkout, and receive delivery instructions by email. Support is available via Instagram, Discord, and a contact form.

## Products

- [DBZ Dokkan Battle accounts](https://accountrift.com/dokkan/products): Dragon Stones accounts with various bonuses and units.
- [DRAGON BALL LEGENDS accounts](https://accountrift.com/legends/products): Chrono Crystals accounts.

## Buying

- Orders are paid through Stripe Checkout (EUR).
- Delivery is by email, usually within 15–60 minutes (up to 24 hours during busy periods).
- [Delivery instructions](https://accountrift.com/instructions): how account linking works and what to include in your message.

## Support

- [FAQ](https://accountrift.com/faqs): answers to common questions.
- [Contact support](https://accountrift.com/support_messages/new): form for order issues.
- [Customer feedback](https://accountrift.com/feedbacks): reviews from completed orders.
